Nature and Stunning Scenery in China

From magical karst mountains to tropical beaches – the most beautiful natural destinations in China

🌿 8 Natural Destinations⏱️ 8 min read
Home◂Tourism in China◂Nature in China

China is characterized by an amazing natural diversity that extends from snow-capped mountains in the west to tropical beaches in the south. The country contains some of the world's most beautiful natural scenery, including UNESCO World Heritage Sites. Arcadia Tourism's programs include trips to these enchanting natural destinations.

Guilin and Yangshuo Karst Mountains 🏔️

The Guilin and Yangshuo region in southern China is one of the most beautiful natural areas in Asia. It is famous for its magical karst mountains that rise amid waters and green fields. The river cruise on the Li River between Guilin and Yangshuo is ranked among the world's most beautiful river cruises, and is among the best tourist activities in China.

Huangshan Mountains (Yellow Mountains) ⛰️

The Huangshan Mountains in Anhui Province are known for their sharp granite peaks surrounded by a sea of clouds and mist. These mountains have inspired Chinese painters and poets for centuries, and are considered one of China's most famous natural sites, listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

West Lake in Hangzhou 🌅

West Lake in Hangzhou is one of China's most famous lakes and a source of inspiration for thousands of poems and paintings. It is distinguished by its enchanting scenery, especially at sunset, and is surrounded by gardens, temples and historic bridges.

Hainan Tropical Beaches 🏖️

Hainan Island in southernmost China is nicknamed "China's Hawaii," distinguished by its white sandy beaches and turquoise waters. The city of Sanya is the main destination for relaxation, featuring luxury resorts and diverse water activities.

Giant Panda Reserve in Chengdu 🐼

Chengdu is home to the world's most famous giant panda reserve. You can see these rare animals in their natural environment – a unique experience only available in China.

Jiuzhaigou Valley 💧

Jiuzhaigou Valley in Sichuan Province is considered a paradise on earth with its colorful waterfalls, turquoise lakes and dense surrounding forests. It is listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List and is considered one of the world's most beautiful natural places.

💡 Best Time to Visit Natural Areas

Spring (April–May) and autumn (September–November) are the best times. Check travel tips for more, and costs for financial planning.
